title: Traceknot update manifest
description: Signed metadata binding an immutable Traceknot release to its source and downloadable artifact.

version.description: Must equal releaseTag without its leading v and the version embedded in artifact.name; the updater enforces this cross-field invariant.

releaseTag.description: Must equal v followed by version; the updater enforces this cross-field invariant.

publishedAt.description: Canonical UTC RFC 3339 lexical form. The updater must additionally calendar-parse and reject impossible dates before freshness evaluation.

name.description: Its embedded semantic version must equal version; the updater enforces this cross-field invariant.
